source_script.narration: Neil Armstrong, Michael Collins and Buzz Aldrin formed the Apollo 11 crew. On July 16, 1969, Apollo 11 launched from Florida. After the lunar landing, Aldrin climbed down from Eagle onto the Moon. On the lunar surface, Aldrin used a core sampler to collect material. On July 24, 1969, the recovered command module was hoisted aboard the USS Hornet.
